details:
Q1: Which part of the repository should this issue change?
Choices:
A) The review/autofix pipeline (`review_autofix.yml` and its scripts)
B) The orchestrator poller (`orchestrate_poll.yml` / `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`)
C) The clarify, plan and implement phases
D) Documentation only (README, `agents.md` fragments)
E) Something else: I will name the file, workflow or behaviour in my answer (RECOMMENDED)
Q2: What concrete problem or outcome does "better" mean here?
Choices:
A) Fix a specific bug or failing run: I will link the run, PR or log line (RECOMMENDED)
B) Cut runtime or API/model cost of a named workflow
C) Improve reliability (fewer stalls or retries) of a named workflow
D) No concrete goal yet: close this issue and refile it with a specific description
Q3: How will we know the change is done?
Choices:
A) I will state a measurable acceptance criterion, such as a test that passes, a metric or a behaviour (RECOMMENDED)
B) A PR that the reviewer panel accepts is enough (not recommended without an answer to Q1 and Q2)
